ambientPrompt: Hear the rhythmic beat of traditional drums mixing with the clatter of horse-drawn carriages on cobblestone, and the distant chiming of metalwork from artisan shops.
musicPrompt: Experience the vibrant sound of the oud and frame drum creating traditional rhythms, mingled with lively Berber influences, evoking a sense of celebration.
languagePhrase: Lorsque vous traversez le souk, attention aux vélos et aux charrettes transportant des marchandises à toute vitesse.
languageTranslation: When you walk through the souk, watch out for bicycles and carts quickly transporting goods.
voiceDescription: Middle-aged Moroccan man with a warm, slightly raspy Marrakchi accent.
